sara_ops: DeployBot started v2 rollout to EU pool-3; ops dashboard shows spike of 422s on /v2/stream. Can we pause the pool? :eyes:
deploybot: roll id=rb-1766721111 started. target pool-3. rollout=10%. error_rate(/v2/stream)=6.9% (alert>1%).

anna_prodeng: tracing a few failed streams — looks like chunk boundary truncation for very long sessions (>6k tokens). sample: `Error: invalid_chunk_size at chunk 42; Transfer-Encoding: chunked; last-chunk-len: 0x3f`.

jon_sre: likely interaction with older edge proxies' chunked parsing. any common front proxies for affected tenants?

sara_ops: tenants 1234 and 9876 are top offenders. Pausing pool-3: `deploybot pause rb-1766721111 --pool pool-3`.

deploybot: pause acknowledged for pool-3; rollout halted for that pool, others unaffected.

mike_release: do we want to rollback or pin to v1 while we fix? Need comms + release note update.

anna_prodeng: root cause: chunking math changes hitting quantization boundary. Short-term mitigation: enable legacy chunker for long contexts. I can build hotpatch in ~40m.

jon_sre: hotpatch OK. Meanwhile pin affected tenants to v1 for stability.

sara_ops: pinning: `deploybot pin-tenant 1234 --api v1`, `deploybot pin-tenant 9876 --api v1`.

deploybot: tenants 1234, 9876 pinned to v1 (cfg commit cfg-9d4e2b).

kate_pm: drafting customer note: "We've paused the EU v2 streaming rollout due to chunking errors on very long sessions. You're pinned to v1 during the fix; no action required." Add ETA once we have it.

mike_release: ETA: hotpatch 40-60m, verification 30m, then unpin & resume. Status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1766721111

anna_prodeng: patch plan: runtime flag `--chunker=legacy-longcontext`, deploy to 2 canaries in pool-3, run 100 long-context synthetic checks, promote if green.

jon_sre: standby for infra support. rollback plan if patch fails: `deploybot rollback rb-1766721111 --region eu` (2 approvals required).

sara_ops: requesting approvals @mike_release @kate_pm for hotpatch + tenant pin.

mike_release: approved.

kate_pm: approved; sending customer note and updating release notes to reflect known issue and mitigation.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/468 ";"
